e7_s4_rejected.label: Fabry Disease
e7_s4_rejected.why: Low α-galactosidase activity is consistent with Fabry Disease, but the absence of paresthesias, dysesthesias, or loss of sensation and the specific pattern of autonomic dysfunction and imaging findings make it less likely.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Frontotemporal Dementia
e7_s4_rejected.why: While cognitive decline is present, the prominent autonomic dysfunction and ataxia are not typical of Frontotemporal Dementia.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Late-Onset Tay-Sachs Disease
e7_s4_rejected.why: This condition typically presents with motor symptoms and cognitive decline, but the autonomic dysfunction and specific imaging findings in this case do not align with Late-Onset Tay-Sachs Disease.

e7_s4_rejected.label: Adult Polyglucosan Body Disease
e7_s4_rejected.why: This condition involves progressive upper and lower motor neuron impairment and dementia, which does not fully match the combination of symptoms and findings in this case, particularly the prominent autonomic features.
